slug: 2025-08-30 Nigeria to launch NGDX, unified data exchange, by end of 2025 (NITDA)

systems.owner: NITDA with the Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy

note: NGDX is described as a data-sharing platform across NIN, BVN, SIM and passport records, scheduled for end 2025; it does not state any system checking people against the NIN.
